A215944.proof: N = 3048841 = 61*151*331 is psp2, divisible by psp2 49981 = 151*331, not of the form p((m+1)p-m)((k+1)p-k) (p <= N^(1/3) forces p = 61; 151 != 1 mod 60), not a multiple of 5461. Lean a215944_counterexample (core). Least: 210 of 798 terms < 1e10 fail, 3048841 first; definition aligned with b-file (count and sum at 1e7..1e10).

A058128.proof: Even n: a(n) = n*S, S = 1 mod n-1, so n^a = n mod a. Lean a058128_weak_psp (core). Same idea as Song's 2022 proof for A343009.

A218483.proof: 5 | N needs 4 | N-1, but N-1 = 14 mod 40. Lean a218483_no_psp. Conjectures 2, 3 are equivalent to N = 1 mod 8 (paper only).

A321790.proof: No counterexample among 6504 semiprime psp2 < 1e10; structural search over p <= 1e5 (q unbounded) finds none. Filled '?' = 873181 = 661*1321 (least semiprime psp2 with least non-witness 7).

A218010-selftest.proof: Pipeline re-finds Greathouse's 3380740301 as the only Carmichael m < 1e10 with 5m = 1 mod 24.

novelty.note: Counterexample and proofs are elementary; nothing new is claimed. 3048841 is already a term of the A215944 b-file but nobody compared it with the conjecture. Web, MathSciNet and zbMATH not searched.
